about: Curated list of official places where opportunities are announced. Edited by research cycles and people. The daily job reads it and writes only data/source-state.json. status: active = scanned and its items become leads; proposed = trial scans only (no leads) until the numbers look right; manual = blocks automated readers, a person opens it each cycle; disabled = switched off. Every entry was opened and probed with scripts/sources.py on verified_on. Never add a source without probing it first.
